# Clair Donnell

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P11](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0011)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Jake  <sub>[v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P11](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0011)</sub>; St. Clair  <sub>[v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P19](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0019)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Clair Donnell's physical appearance is notably marked by a freckled face. This distinct trait is reminiscent of features seen in others.

_Sources: [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P3](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0003)_

## Personality

Clair Donnell is a patriotic individual who respects the devotion of others to their own countries. However, he is noted for lacking a great deal of tact and imagination.

_Sources: [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P13](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0013), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038)_

## History

Mrs. Clair Donnell is the mother of several pupils attending [Anne](../character/anne.md) Shirley's school in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). On Anne's first day of teaching, Mrs. Donnell visited the schoolhouse, excessively dressed, to demand specific pronunciations and names for her children.

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P2](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0002), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P13](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0013), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P14](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0014), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P15](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0015), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P16](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0016), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P17](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0017), +80 more_

## Quotes

> "and I have come in to see you about something Clarice Almira told me when she came home to dinner today. It annoyed me excessively."
>
> — Clair Donnell — [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P13](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0013)

> "Clarice Almira told me that you pronounced our name Donnell. Now, Miss Shirley, the correct pronunciation of our name is Donnell . . . accent on the last syllable. I hope you’ll remember this in future."
>
> — Clair Donnell — [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P15](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0015)

> "Certainly it is. And Clarice Almira also informed me that you call my son Jacob."
>
> — Clair Donnell — [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P17](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0017)

> "Please, miss, I had to help ma make a pudding for dinner ’cause we’re expecting company and Clarice Almira’s sick,"
>
> — Clair Donnell — [v2 XII A Jonah Day P7](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0007)

> "I am Mrs. Donnell . . . Mrs. H. B. Donnell,"
>
> — Clair Donnell — [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P13](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0013)
